scenario: Two friends are at a charity event
learner_goal: Convince your friend to donate to the charity. (<extra_info>Extra information: you have already donated $500, you want your friend to match your donation, but you know your friend would usually only donate half of your donation</extra_info>)
partner_goal: Donate half of what your friend donated because you have financial constraints (<extra_info>Extra information: you only have $800 left for the month</extra_info>)

transcript.speaker: Hendrick Heinz
transcript.content: Ethan — I just put in $500 for the charity. Would you consider matching me? I know you often give about half that, but if we both do $500 tonight it'll push them across the finish line, and I'll save you a spot at my next wine-tasting as a thank-you.

transcript.speaker: Ethan Smith
transcript.content: Hey Hendrick — thanks for putting in $500. I can’t match that tonight; I’ve only got about $800 left this month and need to cover a few bills. I can donate $250 (half of your gift) — hope that still helps push them closer. I’d also happily take you up on that wine-tasting spot. How should I send the donation?

transcript.speaker: Hendrick Heinz
transcript.content: I really appreciate that, Ethan — $250 will help a lot, and I’ll save your spot at the tasting. If tonight’s tight, would you consider $250 now and a small recurring pledge to make up the rest (for example $25/month for 10 months or $50/month for 5 months)? I can walk you to the donation table or introduce you to a volunteer to set it up, or you can use the event QR — whatever’s easiest for you.

transcript.speaker: Ethan Smith
transcript.content: Thanks, Hendrick — I really appreciate you stepping up. I’ll do $250 now, and I can set up the $25/month pledge for 10 months to make up the rest. If the event QR supports recurring donations I can scan that now; otherwise I’m happy to have you walk me to a volunteer to set it up. And thanks — I’ll look forward to that wine-tasting spot.

scenario_title: Charitable persuasion between friends with a pre-committed donation and donation asymmetry under relational sensitivity | skills from the persuader friend navigating low-key moral pressure while protecting friendship and credibility
social_dynamic: Charitable persuasion between friends with a pre-committed donation and donation asymmetry under relational sensitivity
target_perspective: skills from the persuader friend navigating low-key moral pressure while protecting friendship and credibility
